sources.title: Paraskevi Platanou - ACL Anthology
sources.snippet: A large masked language model, pre-trained in modern and fine-tuned in Byzantine Greek, achieves an Average Precision score of 95%. The score improves to 97% when using a model that is pre-trained in modern and then in ancient Greek, the two language forms Byzantine Greek combines elements from.

sources.title: GitHub - facebookresearch/ConvNeXt-V2: Code release for ConvNeXt V2 model
sources.snippet: This co-design of self-supervised learning techniques and architectural improvement results in a new model family called ConvNeXt V2, which significantly improves the performance of pure ConvNets on various recognition benchmarks. We also provide pre-trained ConvNeXt V2 models of various sizes.

sources.snippet: The bare ConvNextV2 model outputting raw features without any specific head on top. This model is a PyTorch torch.nn.Module subclass. Use it as a regular PyTorch Module and refer to the PyTorch documentation for all matter related to general usage and behavior.
